why: a held promise of a value with no identity is a handle, and a handle stored into its optional slot (a field typed Promise<X> | null or | undefined) is Some(handle), never the absent constant its settled value would read as; the absent branch is None only for an actual null or undefined; a Promise<void> in such a slot is the same case; a field of an opaque record (an interface with methods) is written by an uninterpreted update of the record, so the parameter-field form resolves; a renamed local keeps the same transitions
